title: JaldrishtiImageUploadResultContract
description: Shared contract for image ingestion, Cloudinary storage, and frontend preview delivery between Anika (Frontend), Krish (Vision), and Swastik (Backend).

site_id.description: Associated heritage site identifier for hierarchical asset organization.

status.description: Current processing and storage lifecycle status.

preview_url.description: Optimized responsive preview URL for frontend visualization.

thumbnail_url.description: Optimized square thumbnail URL for card and grid displays.

original_url.description: Secure delivery URL for the full-resolution original inspection image.

relevance_confidence.description: Confidence score from the heritage relevance classifier.

rejection_reason.description: Detailed explanation when image is rejected or uncertain.

model_version.description: Identifier of the model that inspected the image.
